Keep the shackle open until pairing is complete. In factory mode, touching the fingerprint sensor with any finger may unlock the lock and release the shackle. Keep clear of the shackle.
Keep the shackle open during fingerprint enrollment to avoid being hit when it springs open.
Keep the shackle open until fingerprint setup is complete.
Touch the fingerprint sensor. A beep from the lock means it is ready. After tapping “Start fingerprint enrollment,” place your finger on the sensor within 20 seconds.
Start fingerprint enrollment
Touch the fingerprint sensor. A beep from the lock means it is ready to pair. Start scanning within 20 seconds.

Place your finger flat on the fingerprint sensor and hold it still. A beep from the lock means that scan was successful. Continue with the same finger, adjusting its position and angle each time, until enrollment is complete.
Scans completed: %1$d of %2$d
If an error appears, lift your finger and place it on the fingerprint sensor again.
Touch the fingerprint sensor and listen for a beep from the lock. If the lock does not respond, make sure it has enough battery and try again. If it still does not respond, contact support.
Allow Populife to use Bluetooth in Settings to connect to the lock.
The lock cannot be found

Turn on Bluetooth and the phone network, and allow Bluetooth access for Populife. Keep the lock within 3 m (10 ft), touch the fingerprint sensor and listen for a beep, then scan again. Keep the shackle open until pairing is complete. If the lock does not respond, make sure it has enough battery.
The lock is already bound

Ask the original owner to transfer ownership or delete the lock from Settings while near the lock. If you cannot contact the owner, contact support with your proof of purchase and a photo of the lock.
